mechanistic_resolution: The full UnifiedDBFingerprint receipt is not a restart-stable lineage identifier. It includes mutable SQLite/main-file observations such as file SHA-256, schema/page metadata and timestamps. The WP206 write path obtains a fingerprint before its own schema/checkpoint writes; legitimate canonical DB evolution therefore changes a later fresh-process fingerprint receipt. Direct historical-receipt == current-receipt equality would reject legitimate restart and is not a valid replay invariant.
